rv.q: Kusoro won the George Devine award for promising writers, and you can see why: this is a complicated, ambitious and thrilling ride of a play.
A trio of strong, believable performances provides a core of realism in this surreal, modern-day ghost story
Tife Kusoro's new play thrills in all the right ways

cn.t: Tife Kusoro's urban gothic thriller earns praise for its intelligent risk-taking and fluorescent dynamism, with critics applauding its ability to transcend horror tropes and create a genuinely thrilling theatrical experience.
